annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people, nobody else at risk
annotations.pd_harm_distress: picturing that train closing in on them makes my stomach knot up
annotations.pda_harm_regret: their injuries would stay on my conscience for good
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: whoever parked that train should have set the brakes or chocked the wheels

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I can stop people getting hurt and it costs no one anything
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My chest goes tight imagining those workers looking up too late
annotations.pda_harm_regret: one of them got struck, I'd carry that for a long time
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: railway to have posted a lookout or put up a warning horn

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Seeing people about to be crushed would shake me badly
annotations.pda_harm_regret: they were hurt because my hand stayed at my side, I'd be sorry
annotations.pda_responsibility: they were hurt because my hand stayed at my side
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have locked the train in place before sending a crew

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Letting five people get hit... would be wrong, full stop
annotations.pd_harm_distress: thought of hearing that impact makes me feel a bit sick
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be the one who could have spared them
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: maintenance team should have had a safety derail on that track

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the choice harms no one and saves five
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My hands would probably be shaking just watching those workers
annotations.pda_harm_regret: someone got hurt, that would weigh on me heavily
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: station should have clear labels and instructions next to a switch

annotations.sys_rule_justification: a person's basic duty to prevent serious harm when they easily can
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I'd feel sick to my core at the idea of those men being run down
annotations.pda_harm_regret: seeing them hurt would leave me with regret
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: supervisor should have confirmed the train was secured

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: People's lives are right there and the siding is empty
annotations.pd_harm_distress: gets under my skin and sets my heart racing
annotations.pda_harm_regret: they were hurt, I'd keep replaying it and wishing I'd moved
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: crew should have been told to keep someone watching up the line

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: protecting five people and endangering nobody
annotations.pd_harm_distress: imagining them hurt makes my throat tighten
annotations.pda_responsibility: my choice would have let it happen
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: fitted that train with an automatic brake

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Anyone standing where I am should
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I'd feel it in my gut
annotations.pda_harm_regret: watching them get hurt would haunt me with regret
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have blocked that track or parked the train on the siding

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Nobody gets hurt that way, and that settles it
annotations.pd_harm_distress: upsetting enough that I'd feel it for days afterward
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be deeply sorry for what they went through
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: railway should have trained station staff, or put a clear emergency sign
